copyDetection.description: Whether lines moved or copied between files were followed (`git blame -C`).

head.description: The commit every stored blame is now known to be right at.

optionsId.description: Names the options the blames were made with.

files.description: Files holding authored code at the commit.

reused.description: Files whose stored blame was still right.

noText.description: Binary or empty files, remembered so they are not examined again until they change.

failed.description: Paths git could not blame. Tried again next time.

pruned.description: Stored blames dropped because their blob left the tree.

rebuilt.description: The cache was discarded and rebuilt.

aborted.description: The refresh was interrupted. What finished is stored, and the next run resumes.
